fullPassage: Science and democracy share important principles and ideals that oppose illegitimate claims for knowledge and power. The authority of both scientific knowledge and democratic governance is legitimated by representation. It is only when this representation is accepted as legitimate that it can support the authority of the knowledge claims made, or the authority of particular forms of governance. Representation is, however, never perfect or complete. Since both scientific practices and democratic governance, in principle, admit potential alternative representations, continuous struggles over what is represented and what is not can be foreseen. To represent means to simplify, which implies the existence of alternatives — alternative ways of simplifying complicated issues. This further means that both science and democracy have inbuilt mechanisms for improvement, which are based on critical assessments of existing representations.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② opposing → oppose: 관계대명사 that 뒤에서 선행사 principles and ideals의 동사 역할을 하므로 정형동사 oppose가 필요. opposing(분사)은 주절 동사로 부적합
det.analysis:
✅ ① share: 복수 주어 Science and democracy에 호응하는 복수 동사로 적절
❌ ② opposing → oppose: 'ideals that opposing illegitimate claims'에서 관계대명사 that 뒤에 주절 동사가 필요하므로 oppose(현재형)가 와야 함. opposing(현재분사)은 정형동사가 아님 ←정답
✅ ③ legitimated: 'is legitimated by'에서 수동태의 과거분사로 적절
✅ ④ accepted: 'is accepted as'에서 수동태의 과거분사로 적절
det.tip: 관계대명사 that 뒤에는 정형동사(finite verb)가 와야 한다. opposing(현재분사)은 정형동사가 될 수 없다.

✅ ① oppose(반대하다): 부당한 주장에 반대한다는 문맥에 적절

❌ ④ stagnation(정체) → improvement: 'mechanisms for stagnation'에서 '향상(improvement)을 위한 메커니즘'이라는 원문인데 stagnation(정체)은 정반대 ←정답
